page.notes: The drop-cap D is a woodcut initial and is joined to the following letters as "Divinitatem". The Greek words after "Omne" are small and partly blurred; the readings marked [?] are uncertain. The second paragraph runs on at the foot of the page to "dens", which is printed flush right on the last line; the final word is therefore not separately listed. Marginal notes on the left are small italic and partly broken; the first note is transcribed as a whole, the second as printed.
